LOCATED_IN_AT_ALL_TIMES: B located in c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (b and c are independent continuants and not spatial regions, and the spatial region which b occupies at t is a (proper or improper) continuant part of the spatial region which c occupies at t). Transitive. Every Facility has one or more 'located in at all times' that is a Site.

GENERICALLY_DEPENDS_ON_AT_SOME_TIME: A g-dependent continuant b g-depends on an independent continuant c at some time =Def for some time t (there inheres in c an s-dependent continuant which concretizes b at t). Its inverse is 'is carrier of at some time'.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ManufacturingService has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a ManufacturingProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'has occurrent part' of a MaterialState is one of ProcessBoundary, MaterialState.

MATERIAL_STATE_HOLDS_IN: Relation between two material states that holds when the first material state is one of the states whose condition contributes to the aggregated condition of the second material state, and the first material state at least occurs for the duration of the second material state.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'has occurrent part' of a MaterialState is one of ProcessBoundary, MaterialState.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every PackagingService has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a PackagingProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'occurrent part of' of a Process is a Process. Every 'has occurrent part' of a Process is one of Process, ProcessBoundary.
HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of a Process is a Process.

BEFORE: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'after'. Transitive.

CAUSES: Relation between a process or event and another process or event that holds when the first has a post material state that is also a pre material state in virtue of which the second is initiated.

MEETS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'met by'.

MODULATES: Relation between a process and another process that holds when the first overlaps the second in time and every state changing temporal part of the first causes some temporal part of the second.

OCCURS_DURING: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'contains occurence of'. Transitive.

OCCURS_SIMULTANEOUSLY_WITH: Relation that holds between two time instants when they are simultaneous or between two intervals when they have same first and last instants or between two processes or two process boundaries when their temporal extents are the same. Symmetric. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_FINISHES: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the last instant of the temporal extent of j and the first instant of j precedes the first instant of i. Its inverse is 'temporally finished by'. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_OVERLAPS: Relation that holds between two intervals and processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j, and the last instance of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'is temporally overlapped by'.

TEMPORALLY_STARTS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as first the instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of i precedes the last instant of j. Its inverse is 'temporally started by'. Transitive.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'has occurrent part' of a Process is one of Process, ProcessBoundary. Every 'occurrent part of' of a ProcessBoundary is one of Process, ProcessBoundary.
HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of a ProcessBoundary is one of Process, ProcessBoundary.

OCCURS_SIMULTANEOUSLY_WITH: Relation that holds between two time instants when they are simultaneous or between two intervals when they have same first and last instants or between two processes or two process boundaries when their temporal extents are the same. Symmetric. Transitive.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'has occurrent part' of a ProcessBoundary is a ProcessBoundary. Every 'occurrent part of' of a ProcessBoundary is one of Process, ProcessBoundary.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'has temporal part' of a ProcessBoundary is a ProcessBoundary. Every 'temporal part of' of a ProcessBoundary is one of Process, ProcessBoundary.

OCCURS_SIMULTANEOUSLY_WITH: Relation that holds between two time instants when they are simultaneous or between two intervals when they have same first and last instants or between two processes or two process boundaries when their temporal extents are the same. Symmetric. Transitive.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ProcuringBusinessProcess has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a BuyingBusinessProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ProcuringBusinessProcess has a 'has occurrent part' that is one of OfferingForSaleBusinessProcess, SupplyingBusinessProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ProcuringBusinessProcess has a 'has occurrent part' that is one of OfferingForSaleBusinessProcess, SupplyingBusinessProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ProductProductionProcess has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a ManufacturingProcess.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of a SpatiotemporalRegion is a SpatiotemporalRegion.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every StorageService has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a StorageProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every SupplyChainTransportProcess has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a TransportProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'occurrent part of' of a TemporalRegion is a TemporalRegion.
HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of a TemporalRegion is a TemporalRegion.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ArrivalProcess has a 'occurrent part of' that is one of TransportProcess, TravelProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every DepartureProcess has a 'occurrent part of' that is one of TransportProcess, TravelProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every TransportationService has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a TransportProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ArrivalProcess has a 'occurrent part of' that is one of TransportProcess, TravelProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every DepartureProcess has a 'occurrent part of' that is one of TransportProcess, TravelProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every WarehousingProcess has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a StorageProcess.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion is an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion. Every 'has temporal part' of an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion is one of OneDimensionalTemporalRegion, ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'has temporal part' of an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion is one of OneDimensionalTemporalRegion, ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'has temporal part' of a ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion is a ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion.

TEMPORALLY_PROJECTS_ONTO: (Elucidation) temporally projects onto is a relation between a spatiotemporal region s and some temporal region which is the temporal extent of s. Each SpatiotemporalRegion has at most one TemporalRegion.
MATERIAL_BASIS_OF_AT_ALL_TIMES: B material basis of c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (c has material basis b at t).
IS_CONCRETIZED_BY_AT_ALL_TIMES: A g-dependent continuant c is concretized by an s-dependent continuant or process b at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (b concretizes c at t).
PARTICIPATES_IN_AT_ALL_TIMES: B participates in p at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (p has participant b at t).
IS_CONCRETIZED_BY_AT_ALL_TIMES: A g-dependent continuant c is concretized by an s-dependent continuant or process b at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (b concretizes c at t).
PARTICIPATES_IN_AT_ALL_TIMES: B participates in p at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (p has participant b at t).
PARTICIPATES_IN_AT_ALL_TIMES: B participates in p at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (p has participant b at t).

HAS_PARTICIPANT_AT_ALL_TIMES: P has participant c at all times =Def for all times t, p exists at t implies (p is a process, c is a continuant, and c participates in p some way at t). Every FailedState has one or more 'has participant at all times' that is a MaintainableMaterialItem.

HAS_PARTICIPANT_AT_ALL_TIMES: P has participant c at all times =Def for all times t, p exists at t implies (p is a process, c is a continuant, and c participates in p some way at t). Every GainOfRole has one or more 'has participant at all times' that is an IndependentContinuant.

HAS_PARTICIPANT_AT_ALL_TIMES: P has participant c at all times =Def for all times t, p exists at t implies (p is a process, c is a continuant, and c participates in p some way at t). Every LossOfRole has one or more 'has participant at all times' that is an IndependentContinuant.

HAS_PARTICIPANT_AT_ALL_TIMES: P has participant c at all times =Def for all times t, p exists at t implies (p is a process, c is a continuant, and c participates in p some way at t). Every MaintenanceProcess has one or more 'has participant at all times' that is a MaintainableMaterialItem.

HAS_INPUT: Relation from a process to someone or something physical or digital (continuant) that is a necessary precondition for the process to start. Its inverse is 'is input of'. Every MaintenanceProcess has one or more 'has input' that is a MaintainableMaterialItem.

HAS_PARTICIPANT_AT_ALL_TIMES: P has participant c at all times =Def for all times t, p exists at t implies (p is a process, c is a continuant, and c participates in p some way at t). Every SupplyChainTransportProcess has one or more 'has participant at all times' that is a Shipment.

LOCATED_IN_AT_SOME_TIME: B located in c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are independent continuants and not spatial regions, and the spatial region which b occupies at t is a (proper or improper) continuant part of the spatial region which c occupies at t). Its inverse is 'location of at some time'. Every 'location of at some time' of a ContinuantFiatBoundary is a ContinuantFiatBoundary.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a ContinuantFiatBoundary is a ContinuantFiatBoundary.

HAS_MEMBER_PART_AT_ALL_TIMES: B has member part c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (c member part b at t). Every 'has member part at all times' of a GroupOfSuppliers is a BusinessOrganization.

HAS_MEMBER_PART_AT_ALL_TIMES: B has member part c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (c member part b at t). Every Industry has one or more 'has member part at all times' that is a BusinessOrganization. Every 'has member part at all times' of an Industry is a BusinessOrganization.

HAS_MEMBER_PART_AT_ALL_TIMES: B has member part c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (c member part b at t). Every SupplyChainSystem has one or more 'has member part at all times' that is a GroupOfSuppliers.

CONTINUANT_PART_OF_AT_ALL_TIMES: B continuant part of c at all times =Def for all times t, (b exists at t, implies b continuant part of c at t & t is a temporal region & b and c are continuants). Transitive. Every MaterialStateConditionExpression has one or more 'continuant part of at all times' that is a MaterialStateSpecification.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a FiatLine is one of FiatLine, FiatPoint.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a FiatLine is one of FiatLine, FiatPoint.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a FiatPoint is a FiatPoint.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a FiatSurface is a ContinuantFiatBoundary.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every MaterialTradeItem has one or more 'continuant part of at some time' that is a LogisticUnit.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a MaterialEntity is one of Site, ContinuantFiatBoundary, MaterialEntity.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a MaterialEntity is one of Site, ContinuantFiatBoundary, MaterialEntity. Every 'continuant part of at some time' of a Site is one of Site, MaterialEntity.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of an OneDimensionalSpatialRegion is one of OneDimensionalSpatialRegion, ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of an OneDimensionalSpatialRegion is one of OneDimensionalSpatialRegion, ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a Site is one of Site, ContinuantFiatBoundary.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'continuant part of at some time' of a Site is one of Site, MaterialEntity. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a Site is one of Site, ContinuantFiatBoundary.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'continuant part of at some time' of a SpatialRegion is a SpatialRegion.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a ThreeDimensionalSpatialRegion is a SpatialRegion.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a TwoDimensionalSpatialRegion is one of TwoDimensionalSpatialRegion, OneDimensionalSpatialRegion, ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion.

HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. HAS_CONTINUANT_PART_AT_SOME_TIME: B has continuant part c at some time =Def for some time t (b and c are continuants & b is a part of c at t). Its inverse is 'continuant part of at some time'. Every 'has continuant part at some time' of a ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion is a ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion.
ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'.
ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'.
ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'.
ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'.
ENVIRONS: B environs c =Def c occurs in b. Its inverse is 'occurs in'. Every WarehousingProcess has one or more 'occurs in' that is a StorageFacility.
HAS_HISTORY: B has history c =Def c history of b. Its inverse is 'history of'.

SPECIFICALLY_DEPENDS_ON: (Elucidation) b specifically depends on c means: b and c do not share common parts & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist at t unless c exists at t & b is not a boundary of c. Its inverse is 'specifically depended on by'.
INHERES_IN: B inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b s-depends on c. Its inverse is 'bearer of'.

SPECIFICALLY_DEPENDS_ON: (Elucidation) b specifically depends on c means: b and c do not share common parts & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist at t unless c exists at t & b is not a boundary of c. Its inverse is 'specifically depended on by'.

SPECIFICALLY_DEPENDS_ON: (Elucidation) b specifically depends on c means: b and c do not share common parts & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist at t unless c exists at t & b is not a boundary of c. Its inverse is 'specifically depended on by'. Every SupplyRelationship has one or more 'specifically depends on' that is a CustomerRole.

SPECIFICALLY_DEPENDS_ON: (Elucidation) b specifically depends on c means: b and c do not share common parts & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist at t unless c exists at t & b is not a boundary of c. Its inverse is 'specifically depended on by'. Every SupplyRelationship has one or more 'specifically depends on' that is a SupplierRole.

INHERES_IN: B inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b s-depends on c. Its inverse is 'bearer of'. Every BusinessOrganization has one or more 'bearer of' that is a BusinessFunction.

INHERES_IN: B inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b s-depends on c. Its inverse is 'bearer of'. Every EngineeredSystem has one or more 'bearer of' that is a DesignedFunction.

INHERES_IN: B inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b s-depends on c. Its inverse is 'bearer of'. Every MaterialArtifact has one or more 'bearer of' that is a DesignedFunction.

INHERES_IN: B inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b s-depends on c. Its inverse is 'bearer of'. Every OrganizedGroupOfAgents has one or more 'bearer of' that is a Function.

OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Every ArrivalProcess has one or more 'occupies temporal region' that is a TemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Every DepartureProcess has one or more 'occupies temporal region' that is a TemporalRegion.
OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Each Process has at most one TemporalRegion.
OCCURS_ON: Relation which holds between some processual entity and some temporal region whenever the duration of the processual entity is contained by the temporal region.
OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Each ProcessBoundary has at most one TemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_TEMPORAL_REGION: P occupies temporal region t =Def the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t. Every ProductProductionProcess has one or more 'occupies temporal region' that is a TemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIOTEMPORAL_REGION: (Elucidation) p occupies spatiotemporal region s is a relation between an occurrent p and the spatiotemporal region s which is its spatiotemporal extent. Each Process has at most one SpatiotemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIOTEMPORAL_REGION: (Elucidation) p occupies spatiotemporal region s is a relation between an occurrent p and the spatiotemporal region s which is its spatiotemporal extent. Each ProcessBoundary has at most one SpatiotemporalRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIAL_REGION_AT_SOME_TIME: An independent continuant c that is not a spatial region occupies spatial region r at some time =Def for some time t (every continuant part of c occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of c occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t).

OCCUPIES_SPATIAL_REGION_AT_ALL_TIMES: An independent continuant c that is not a spatial region occupies spatial region r at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (every continuant part of c occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of c occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t). Each IndependentContinuant has at most one SpatialRegion.

OCCUPIES_SPATIAL_REGION_AT_SOME_TIME: An independent continuant c that is not a spatial region occupies spatial region r at some time =Def for some time t (every continuant part of c occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of c occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t). Every 'occupies spatial region at some time' of a Site is a ThreeDimensionalSpatialRegion.
SPATIALLY_PROJECTS_ONTO_AT_SOME_TIME: B spatially projects onto c at some time =Def for some time t (b is a spatiotemporal region and c is a spatial region and c is the spatial extent of b at t).

SPATIALLY_PROJECTS_ONTO_AT_ALL_TIMES: B spatially projects onto c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (b is a spatiotemporal region and c is a spatial region and c is the spatial extent of b at t). Each SpatiotemporalRegion has at most one SpatialRegion.
IS_CARRIER_OF_AT_ALL_TIMES: B is carrier of c at all times =Def for all times t, b exists at t implies (c g-depends on b at t).
HAS_FIRST_INSTANT: T has first instant t' =Def t' first instant of t. Its inverse is 'first instant of'. Each TemporalRegion has at most one TemporalInstant.
HAS_LAST_INSTANT: T has last instant t' =Def t' last instant of t. Its inverse is 'last instant of'. Each TemporalRegion has at most one TemporalInstant.

ACHIEVES_AT_SOME_TIME: Relation from a process to an information content entity wherein the process partially or fully concretizes the information content entity. Its inverse is 'is achieved by at some time'.

ACTS_ON_BEHALF_OF_AT_SOME_TIME: Relation from a material entity to a person or a group of agents or engineered system that holds when the material entity participates in some planned process in order to fulfill an objective for the person or group of agents or engineered system.

ACTS_ON_BEHALF_OF_AT_SOME_TIME: Relation from a material entity to a person or a group of agents or engineered system that holds when the material entity participates in some planned process in order to fulfill an objective for the person or group of agents or engineered system.

ACTS_ON_BEHALF_OF_AT_SOME_TIME: Relation from a material entity to a person or a group of agents or engineered system that holds when the material entity participates in some planned process in order to fulfill an objective for the person or group of agents or engineered system.

BEFORE: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'after'. Transitive.

MEETS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'met by'.

OCCURS_DURING: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'contains occurence of'. Transitive.

OCCURS_SIMULTANEOUSLY_WITH: Relation that holds between two time instants when they are simultaneous or between two intervals when they have same first and last instants or between two processes or two process boundaries when their temporal extents are the same. Symmetric. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_FINISHES: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the last instant of the temporal extent of j and the first instant of j precedes the first instant of i. Its inverse is 'temporally finished by'. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_OVERLAPS: Relation that holds between two intervals and processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j, and the last instance of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'is temporally overlapped by'.

TEMPORALLY_STARTS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as first the instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of i precedes the last instant of j. Its inverse is 'temporally started by'. Transitive.

CATEGORIZES: Relation between classifiers in which a higher-order classifier classifies a lower-order classifier and designates a set that has as members only sets designated by lower-order classifiers that it organizes. Its inverse is 'categorized by'.
SPECIALIZES: Relation between two classifiers such that everything classified by the former is also classified by the latter. Its inverse is 'generalizes'. Transitive.

CAUSES: Relation between a process or event and another process or event that holds when the first has a post material state that is also a pre material state in virtue of which the second is initiated.

CLASSIFIES: Relation that holds between an information content entity x and an entity y when the information content entity designates a set whose members are instances of a particular type and y is a member of that set. Its inverse is 'classified by'. Every Classifier has one or more 'classifies' that is an Entity.

CLASSIFIES: Relation that holds between an information content entity x and an entity y when the information content entity designates a set whose members are instances of a particular type and y is a member of that set. Its inverse is 'classified by'.
DENOTES: Relation from an information content entity to an entity that the information content entity distinguishes. Its inverse is 'denoted by'.
DESCRIBES: Relation from an information content entity to an entity that the information content entity characterizes. Its inverse is 'described by'.

DESIGNATES: Relation from an information content entity to an entity that the information content entity uniquely distinguishes from other entities. Its inverse is 'designated by'. Each InformationContentEntity has at most one Entity.
IS_ABOUT: Primitive, generic relationship between an information content entity and some entity. Its inverse is 'is subject of'.

PRESCRIBES: Relation from an information content entity to an entity such that the information content entity serves as a collection of rules or guide for the entity if the entity is something that unfolds in time (occurrent), or as a model if the entity is someone or something physical or digital (continuant). Its inverse is 'prescribed by'.

COMPONENT_PART_OF_AT_ALL_TIMES: Relation from a material entity to another material entity that it is a proper part of at all times it exists. Transitive. Every Assembly is reached by one or more 'component part of at all times' from a MaterialComponent.

g.title: ActionSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes what participants shall do in a process. Properties: uri
AdvanceShipmentNotice — Information content entity about a shipment, sent by a supplier or consignor to a buyer or consignee, before the shipment’s arrival. Properties: uri
Agent — Person, group of persons, or engineered system with an agent role. Properties: uri
AgentRole — Role that someone or something has when they act on behalf of a person, engineered system or a group of agents. Properties: uri
Agreement — Understanding between two or more parties that contains a set of commitments on the part of the parties. Properties: uri
Airway — Three-dimensional spatial region that connects one specified location (navigation point) to another at a specified altitude, along which an aircraft may be flown. Properties: uri
Algorithm — Information content entity that prescribes procedural or declarative steps which can be translated to computer interpretable instructions. Properties: uri
AppraisalProcess — Measurement process that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the nature, value, importance, condition, or quality of some entity. Properties: uri

ArrivalProcess — Material location change process that consists of the participating entity reaching its destination such that the travel or transport process which it is a part of is completed. Properties: uri
Assembly — Material artifact that is composed of material components that are physically connected and that is capable of disassembly. Properties: uri
AssemblyProcess — Manufacturing process in which a number of material components are physically connected to each other to form an assembly. Properties: uri
BillOfLading — Agreement between a shipper and a carrier that prescribes some consigning process. Properties: uri
BusinessFunction — Function of an organization to partake in for profit activities as prescribed by the objectives specified by that organization. Properties: uri
BusinessOrganization — Organization engaging in or planning to engage in any activity of buying and selling goods or services for a profit. Properties: uri
BusinessProcess — Planned process which is prescribed by a plan specification with one or more objectives specified by a business organization. Properties: uri
Buyer — Person or organization which has a buyer role. Properties: uri
BuyerRole — Agent role held by a person or organization when it buys a product or a service. Properties: uri

BuyingBusinessProcess — Business process wherein a financial instrument is used by an agent (buyer) to acquire ownership of a product or commercial service from another agent (seller) for the buyer itself or for another agent (customer). Properties: uri
Capability — Disposition in whose realization some agent has an interest. Properties: uri
Cargo — Material entity that is transported using a transport equipment by a carrier. Properties: uri
CargoRole — Role held by a material entity when it is being transported or is planned to be transported by a carrier. Properties: uri
Carrier — Person or business organization who provides transportation services. Properties: uri

Change — Process in which some independent continuant endures and 1) one or more of the dependent entities it bears increase or decrease in intensity, 2) the entity begins to bear some dependent entity or 3) the entity ceases to bear some dependent entity. Properties: uri
Classifier — Denoter that classifies some entity. Properties: uri
CommercialService — Business process that consists of a service provisioning process and a consumption process. Properties: uri

CommercialServiceAgreement — Agreement between a customer and service provider that is about some commercial service to be provided by the service provider in exchange for compensation from the customer. Properties: uri
CommercialServiceSpecification — Plan specification that prescribes a commercial service. Properties: uri
ComplexMaterialState — Material state whose condition is an aggregated condition composed from the conditions of two or more material states that hold in it. Properties: uri
ComputingProcess — Planned process in which an algorithm or an encoded algorithm is realized by an agent. Properties: uri
Consignee — Person or business organization that receives some shipment. Properties: uri
ConsigneeRole — Role held by a person or business organization when it receives a shipment from a carrier and owns the shipment after the receipt. Properties: uri
ConsigningProcess — Business process that results in placing a material entity in the possession of some agent without changing the ownership until the material entity is sold. Properties: uri
Consignor — Person or business organization that prepares and sends shipments for transport. Properties: uri
ConsignorRole — Role held by a business organization or person when it prepares, initiates, and consigns a shipment it owns. Properties: uri
Consumable — Material entity which has the consumable role. Properties: uri
ConsumableRole — Role held by a material entity when it is planned to be, or is partially or fully used up in a planned process. Properties: uri
Container — Material artifact designed to hold one or more material entities within a bounded interior, cavity, surface-delimited area, or contained site. Properties: uri
ContainerIdentifier — Identifier that identifies a container. Properties: uri
Continuant — (Elucidation) A continuant is an entity that persists, endures, or continues to exist through time while maintaining its identity. Properties: uri

ContinuantFiatBoundary — (Elucidation) b is a continuant fiat boundary means: b is an immaterial entity that is of zero, one or two dimensions, which is such that there is no time t when b has a spatial region as continuant part at t, and whose location is determined in relation to some material entity. Properties: uri
Customer — Person or organization which has a customer role. Properties: uri
CustomerRole — Agent role held by a person or organization when it utilizes the product or receives the service or subscribes to the commercial service agreement. Properties: uri
DegradedState — State of reduced ability to perform as required but with acceptable reduced performance. Properties: uri
Denoter — Information content entity that denotes some entity. Properties: uri

DepartureProcess — Material location change process that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the travel or transport process it is a part of is initiated. Properties: uri
DescriptiveInformationContentEntity — Information content entity that characterizes (gives a description of) an entity. Properties: uri
DesignSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes something man-made. Properties: uri
DesignativeInformationContentEntity — Information content entity that uniquely identifies an entity. Properties: uri
DesignedFunction — Function that is intentionally designed. Properties: uri
DirectiveInformationContentEntity — Information content entity that prescribes a set of rules or guidelines for a process or a model of something man-made. Properties: uri

Disposition — (Elucidation) b is a disposition means: b is a realizable entity & b is such that if it ceases to exist, then its bearer is physically changed, & b's realization occurs when and because this bearer is in some special physical circumstances, & this realization occurs in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up. Properties: uri
DispositionToExhibitUndesirableBehavior — Disposition of an item that would not be expected under normal operating conditions. Properties: uri
DispositionToFail — Disposition of an item to undergo a failure process. Properties: uri
DistributionCenter — Storage facility designed to store manufactured products that are to be distributed to resellers and wholesalers. Properties: uri
Distributor — Person or business organization when it purchases products from manufacturers and resells them to wholesalers. Properties: uri
DistributorRole — Role held by a person or business organization when it buys some material products from a manufacturer and resells them to a wholesaler. Properties: uri
EncodedAlgorithm — Plan specification that is the implementation of an algorithm encoded in a specific programming language or framework and that is readily executable. Properties: uri
EngineeredSystem — System that is deliberately created to have a certain function. Properties: uri
Entity — (Elucidation) An entity is anything that exists or has existed or will exist. Properties: uri

EquipmentRole — Role held by a material artifact or an engineered system when it is planned to be involved in or is involved in carrying out some part of a planned process and that is not consumed in that planned process. Properties: uri
Event — Phenomena (process or process boundary) that is recognized by an agent and typically recorded. Properties: uri
Facility — Engineered system that consists of buildings, structures, roads, machines, and equipment designed to provide certain capabilities. Properties: uri
Factory — Facility that is designed for manufacturing products and includes one or more production systems. Properties: uri
FailedState — State of an item being unable to perform a required function due to a failure event. Properties: uri
FailureEffect — Process that is the consequence of failure, within or beyond the boundary of the failed item. Properties: uri
FailureEvent — Event that causes an item to lose its ability to perform a required function. Properties: uri
FailureModeCode — Information content entity that describes an undesirable disposition. Properties: uri
FailureProcess — Process that changes some quality of an item causing the item to become degraded or failed. Properties: uri
FiatLine — (Elucidation) a fiat line is a one-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is continuous. Properties: uri

FiatObjectPart — (Elucidation) a fiat object part b is a material entity which is such that for all times t, if b exists at t then there is some object c such that b is a proper continuant part of c at t and b is demarcated from the remainder of c by one or more fiat surfaces. Properties: uri
FiatPoint — (Elucidation) a fiat point is a zero-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that consists of a single point. Properties: uri
FiatSurface — (Elucidation) a fiat surface is a two-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is self-connected. Properties: uri
FreightContainer — A container that is designed to enclose, protect, and enable the transport of one or more material entities across multiple modes of transportation. Properties: uri
FreightForwarder — Person or business organization when it arranges the transportation of shipments on behalf of the shipper (consignor) or consignee. Properties: uri
FreightForwarderRole — Logistics service provider role held by an agent when it arranges the transportation of shipments on behalf of the shipper (consignor) or consignee. Properties: uri
FreightForwardingBusinessFunction — Business function that is realized in a freight forwarding service. Properties: uri
FreightForwardingProcess — Business process of planning and coordinating the transportation of material products on behalf of a shipper. Properties: uri
FreightForwardingService — Logistics service that consists of at least one freight forwarding process. Properties: uri

Function — (Elucidation) A function is a disposition that exists in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up and this physical make-up is something the bearer possesses because it came into being either through evolution (in the case of natural biological entities) or through intentional design (in the case of artefacts), in order to realize processes of a certain sort. Properties: uri
FunctioningProcess — Process in which an item performs its function. Properties: uri
GainOfRole — Process in which someone or something (independent continuant that is not a spatial region) becomes the bearer of a role. Properties: uri

GenericallyDependentContinuant — (Elucidation) a generically dependent continuant is an entity that exists in virtue of the fact that there is at least one of what may be multiple copies; it is the content or the pattern that the multiple copies share. Properties: uri
GeospatialLocation — Geospatial site that is the location of some material entity at some time or the site of some process. Properties: uri
GeospatialSite — Site at or near the surface of the earth. Properties: uri
GlobalLocationNumber — Identifier that uniquely identifies a business organization or a geospatial location and complies with GS1 GLN coding scheme. Properties: uri
GroupOfAgents — Group (object aggregate) that has one or more agents as members. Properties: uri
GroupOfPersons — Group (object aggregate) that has one or more persons as members. Properties: uri
GroupOfSuppliers — Group of agents involved in trading and other business relationships with one another during the operation of specific supply chains. Properties: uri

History — (Elucidation) A history is a process that is the sum of the totality of processes taking place in the spatiotemporal region occupied by the material part of a material entity. Properties: uri
Identifier — Denoter that is used to uniquely identify an entity within a particular context. Properties: uri
ImmaterialEntity — A is an immaterial entity =Def a is an independent continuant which is such that there is no time t when it has a material entity as continuant part at t. Properties: uri
IndependentContinuant — B is an independent continuant =Def b is a continuant which is such that there is no c such that b s-depends on c and no c such that b g-depends on c. Properties: uri

IndustrialInventory — Material product, material component, raw material, or material artifact that is ready to be sold or used and is stored in a storage facility or on factory floor. Properties: uri

IndustrialInventoryRole — Role held by some material entity when it is stored by a business organization and it is intended to be supplied to a customer or to be used or consumed in some product production process. Properties: uri
Industry — Group of organizations that are related based on their primary business activities. Properties: uri
InformationContentEntity — Content or a pattern (generically dependent continuant) that is about some entity. Properties: uri
InputSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes the entities to be used as inputs to a planned process or the attributes they must posses to serve as valid inputs. Properties: uri
IntegratedCarrierBusinessOrganization — Business organization that is created for the purpose of providing different types of transportation and freight forwarding services. Properties: uri
InventoryManagementProcess — Business process that consists of the activities required for controlling, tracking, recording, and planning inventories. Properties: uri
Load — Collection of material entities which share the same transportation and transfer history. Properties: uri
LoadRole — Traceable resource unit role held by a number of material entities that have been transferred or transported together. Properties: uri
LocationIdentificationScheme — Identification scheme that prescribes how unique identifiers of physical locations are formulated. Properties: uri
LocationRole — Role held by a geospatial site when it is the location of some material entity at some time or the site of some process. Properties: uri
LogisticUnit — Material entities packaged together for transport or storage. Properties: uri
LogisticUnitRole — Traceable resource unit role held by a number of material entities that are packaged together for transport or storage. Properties: uri

LogisticsProcess — Business process composed of one or more processes such as transport, shipment preparation, storage, or receiving that are coordinated to enable the movement, handling, or distribution of material entities across one or more locations within a supply chain. Properties: uri
LogisticsService — Commercial service that consists of at least one transport process, packaging process, freight forwarding, or storage process. Properties: uri
LogisticsServiceProviderRole — Service provider role that is held by a business organization or person when it provides a logistics service. Properties: uri
LossOfRole — Process in which someone or something (independent continuant that is not a spatial region) ceases to be the bearer of a role. Properties: uri
Lot — Quantity of material entities produced together and sharing the same production history and specifications. Properties: uri
LotIdentifier — Identifier that uniquely denotes a particular quantity of material entities that have shared production or transformation history. Properties: uri
LotRole — Traceable resource unit role held by material entities that have a shared production or transformation history. Properties: uri
MaintainableMaterialItem — Material artifact or engineered system which has the maintainable material item role. Properties: uri
MaintainableMaterialItemRole — Role played by an asset (engineered system or material artifact) when there is a maintenance strategy prescribing its maintenance process. Properties: uri
MaintenanceActivity — Maintenance process that is a single task to retain or restore the function of a maintainable material item. Properties: uri
MaintenanceProcess — Process to do with retaining or restoring the function of a maintainable material item under a maintenance strategy. Properties: uri

MaintenanceState — Stasis that holds during a temporal interval when the realizable functions and capabilities of the participating item, or the grade of realization of those functions and capabilities, remain unchanged. Properties: uri
MaintenanceStrategy — Maintenance (method/ approach/ actions) to enable (the/an) asset to achieve (management's/ desired) objectives. Properties: uri
MaintenanceWorkOrderRecord — Information content entity that describes a maintenance process. Properties: uri
MakeToOrderProductionCapability — Production capability to manufacture some material artifact only after a confirmed customer order is received. Properties: uri
MakeToStockProductionCapability — Production capability to manufacture and store some product to fulfill the expected incoming orders or forecasted demand. Properties: uri
Manufacturer — Organization which has a manufacturer role. Properties: uri
ManufacturerRole — Agent role held by an organization when it produces material products. Properties: uri
ManufacturingProcess — Planned process that consists of a structured set of operations through which input material is transformed or modified. Properties: uri
ManufacturingService — Commercial service that consists of at least one manufacturing process. Properties: uri
ManufacturingServiceProviderRole — Service provider role that is held by a person or business organization when it provides a manufacturing service. Properties: uri
ManufacturingSupplyChainSystem — Supply chain system that is formed to manufacture one or more products. Properties: uri
MaterialArtifact — Object that is deliberately created to have a certain function. Properties: uri
MaterialComponent — Material entity which has the material component role. Properties: uri
MaterialComponentRole — Role held by a material entity when it is a proper part of another material entity or is planned to be a proper part of another material entity. Properties: uri

MaterialContainmentCapability — Capability of a material entity that is grounded in the entity’s physical structure and that can be realized in a process in which the entity holds one or more material entities within a bounded interior, cavity, surface-delimited area, or contained site. Properties: uri
MaterialContainmentFunction — Material containment capability that is a function of a material entity. Properties: uri
MaterialEntity — (Elucidation) A material entity is an independent continuant that at all times at which it exists has some portion of matter as continuant part. Properties: uri
MaterialLocationChangeProcess — Planned process that results in a material entity moving from one physical location to another. Properties: uri
MaterialProduct — Material entity which has the material product role. Properties: uri
MaterialProductRole — Role held by a material entity that is intended to be sold, or has been bought, or has been supplied. Properties: uri
MaterialResource — Material entity which has the material resource role. Properties: uri
MaterialResourceRole — Role played by a material entity that consists in it being available to a person or group of agents or engineered system. Properties: uri
MaterialState — Process in which a material entity that participates in the process has a condition that remains unchanged. Properties: uri

MaterialStateConditionExpression — Value expression that, as part of a material state specification, expresses a condition on a characteristic, profile, quality, location, or other relevant feature, to which the material state prescribed by that specification continuously conforms throughout its occurrence. Properties: uri
MaterialStateSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes a material state. Properties: uri
MaterialTradeItem — Material entity that is uniquely identified and is intended to be offered for sale in a selling business process. Properties: uri

MaterialTradeItemRole — Role of a material product, package of, or group of material products when it is intended to be offered for sale in a selling business process and is identified for trade. Properties: uri

MeasuredValueExpression — Value expression that contains the measured value of an attribute (specifically dependent continuant or process characteristic or process profile or temporal region). Properties: uri
MeasurementCapability — Capability of a material entity to measure the value of some entity. Properties: uri

MeasurementInformationContentEntity — Informational content that is the result of measuring a set of attributes (specifically dependent continuant or process characteristic or temporal region) belonging to the entity (independent continuant or process or process boundary) the informational content is about. Properties: uri

MeasurementProcess — Planned process to determine the value of an attribute (specifically dependent continuant or temporal region or process characteristic or process profile) of an entity of interest. Properties: uri
Object — (Elucidation) an object is a material entity which manifests causal unity & is of a type instances of which are maximal relative to the sort of causal unity manifested. Properties: uri
ObjectAggregate — (Elucidation) an object aggregate is a material entity consisting exactly of a plurality (≥1) of objects as member parts which together form a unit. Properties: uri
ObjectiveSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes what the outcome of some process should be. Properties: uri
Occurrent — (Elucidation) An occurrent is an entity that unfolds itself in time or it is the start or end of such an entity or it is a temporal or spatiotemporal region. Properties: uri

OfferingForSaleBusinessProcess — Business process wherein a product or commercial service is offered by an agent (seller) for another agent (buyer) to acquire ownership via a financial instrument. Properties: uri
OneDimensionalSpatialRegion — (Elucidation) A one-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a line together with zero or more lines and/or points as parts. Properties: uri

OneDimensionalTemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A one-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region is a whole that has a temporal interval and zero or more temporal intervals and temporal instants as parts. Properties: uri
OperatingState — State of an item being able to perform a required function. Properties: uri
Organization — Group of persons that identifies itself by some name and pursues a common set of plans and objectives. Properties: uri
OrganizationIdentifier — Identifier that identifies an organization. Properties: uri
OrganizedGroupOfAgents — Group of agents that is pursuing a common set of plans and objectives. Properties: uri

OutputObjectiveSpecification — Objective specification that prescribes the entities to be produced or modified in a planned process or the attributes they must posses to serve as valid outputs. Properties: uri
PackagingPlanSpecification — Plan specification that prescribes a packaging process. Properties: uri
PackagingProcess — Business process of putting some products or some portion of material into a package according to a packaging plan specification. Properties: uri
PackagingService — Logistics service that consists of at least one packaging process. Properties: uri
PackagingServiceProviderRole — Logistics service provider role held by a business organization or person when it provides a packaging service. Properties: uri
PackingList — Information content entity that describes one or more logistic units planned to participate in some logistics process. Properties: uri
Person — Organism that is the member of the species of homo sapiens. Properties: uri
PhysicalLocationIdentifier — Identifier that identifies a physical location (site). Properties: uri
PieceOfEquipment — Material artifact or engineered system with an equipment role. Properties: uri
PieceOfTransportEquipment — Material artifact which has a transport equipment role. Properties: uri
PlanSpecification — Information content entity that has action specifications and objective specifications as parts. Properties: uri
PlannedProcess — Process that is prescribed by a plan specification. Properties: uri
Process — (Elucidation) p is a process means p is an occurrent that has some temporal proper part and for some time t, p has some material entity as participant at t. Properties: uri
ProcessBoundary — P is a process boundary =Def p is a temporal part of a process & p has no proper temporal parts. Properties: uri
ProcessCharacteristic — Continuant that summarizes an attribute of a process over its entire duration, providing a time-independent characterization of the process as a whole. Properties: uri
ProcessProfile — Process that is proper part of another process and that captures the time-dependent behavior of some attribute of that process. Properties: uri
ProcuringBusinessProcess — Business process that consists of buying and ensuring the supply of products or services. Properties: uri

ProductProductionProcess — Business process that consists of at least one manufacturing process through which raw materials and components are transformed or modified to create a material product. Properties: uri
ProductionCapability — Capability of an agent or a system that is realized in a product production process. Properties: uri
PurchaseOrder — Agreement between a buyer and a seller that contains a set of commitments undertaken by the buyer and the seller. Properties: uri
QualificationSpecification — Requirement specification that identifies the need for a person to have an assessed skill for a specific task. Properties: uri
QualifiedMaintenancePerson — Person who is qualified to perform a specified maintenance activity. Properties: uri
Quality — (Elucidation) a quality is a specifically dependent continuant that, in contrast to roles and dispositions, does not require any further process in order to be realized. Properties: uri
RawMaterial — Material entity which has the raw material role. Properties: uri

RawMaterialRole — Role held by a material entity when it is acquired by an organizational entity with some plan to transform or modify it into intermediate-level components or substances or into a product. Properties: uri

RealizableEntity — (Elucidation) b is a realizable entity means: b is a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in some independent continuant which is not a spatial region and is of a type some instances of which are realized in processes of a correlated type. Properties: uri
ReceivingProcess — Planned process in which an agent receives some material entity from another agent. Properties: uri
RelationalQuality — B is a relational quality =Def b is a quality and there exists c and d such that b and c are not identical, & b s-depends on c & b s-depends on d. Properties: uri
RequiredFunction — Function of a maintainable material item which is considered necessary to fulfil a process requirement. Properties: uri
RequirementSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes a set of requirements. Properties: uri
Retailer — Person or business organization who buys products from wholesalers and manufacturers and resells them to end users. Properties: uri

RetailerRole — Role held by a person or business organization when it buys products (material product) from manufacturers or wholesalers and offers them for sale to customers who are the end users of the product. Properties: uri

Role — (Elucidation) b is a role means: b is a realizable entity & b exists because there is some single bearer that is in some special physical, social, or institutional set of circumstances in which this bearer does not have to be & b is not such that, if it ceases to exist, then the physical make-up of the bearer is thereby changed. Properties: uri
Seaway — Three-dimensional spatial region that connects one specified location to another on a body of water along which a watercraft may travel. Properties: uri
ServiceConsumerRole — Customer role held by a person or business organization when it receives and consumes a service. Properties: uri
ServiceProvider — Person or organization which has a service provider role. Properties: uri
ServiceProviderRole — Supplier role held by a person or organization when it offers to sell or provide a commercial service. Properties: uri
ServiceSupplyChainSystem — Supply chain system that is formed to deliver some commercial services. Properties: uri
ShipFromLocation — Geospatial location at which some dispatch process occurs. Properties: uri
ShipFromLocationRole — Location role held by a geospatial site when it is the location at which some dispatch process occurs. Properties: uri
ShipToLocation — Geospatial location in which some receiving process occurs. Properties: uri
ShipToLocationRole — Location role held by a geospatial site when it is the location at which some receiving process occurs. Properties: uri
Shipment — Collection of material entities delivered to a receiver's location that have undergone the same dispatch and receipt processes. Properties: uri
ShipmentPlanSpecification — Plan specification that prescribes a shipment preparation process and a transportation process. Properties: uri
ShipmentPreparationProcess — Business process in which some material entities are prepared to be transported together to a receiver’s location. Properties: uri
ShipmentRole — Traceable resource unit role held by material entities when they undergo the same dispatch and receipt processes as prescribed by a bill of lading. Properties: uri
ShipmentState — Material state in which a shipment that participates in the state has a condition that remains unchanged. Properties: uri
ShippingRoute — Way (three-dimensional spatial region) that connects two or more supply chain nodes along which some shipment travels during a transport process. Properties: uri

Site — (Elucidation) b is a site means: b is a three-dimensional immaterial entity whose boundaries either (1) (partially or wholly) coincide with the boundaries of one or more material entities or (2) have locations determined in relation to some material entity. Properties: uri
SpatialRegion — (Elucidation) A spatial region is a continuant entity that is a continuant part of the spatial projection of a portion of spacetime at a given time. Properties: uri
SpatiotemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A spatiotemporal region is an occurrent that is an occurrent part of spacetime. Properties: uri

SpecificallyDependentContinuant — B is a specifically dependent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region & which is such that b s-depends on c. Properties: uri
StorageCapability — Capability of an agent or a system that is realized in a storage process. Properties: uri
StorageFacility — Facility that is designed to store materials or goods. Properties: uri
StorageProcess — Planned process of putting and keeping material entities in a specified location for future use. Properties: uri
StorageService — Logistics service that consists of at least one storage process. Properties: uri
StorageServiceProviderRole — Logistics service provider role that is held by a person or business organization when it provides a storage service. Properties: uri
Sublot — Material entity which has a sublot role. Properties: uri
SublotRole — Traceable resource unit role held by a material entity when it is part of a lot and is uniquely identifiable within that lot. Properties: uri
Supplier — Person or organization which has a supplier role. Properties: uri

SupplierEvaluationProcess — Appraisal process that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the capabilities of a person or organization that is intended to become a member of a supply chain. Properties: uri
SupplierRole — Agent role held by a person or organization when it offers to sell or provide products or services. Properties: uri
SupplyChainAgent — Person or business organization who supplies material products or commercial services to other agents in a supply chain. Properties: uri

SupplyChainAgentRole — Role held by an agent that is a part of a supply chain system when it supplies material products or commercial services to other agents in the supply chain system. Properties: uri
SupplyChainNode — Geospatial location that is the site of some supply chain process. Properties: uri
SupplyChainNodeRole — Location role held by a geospatial site when it is the site of some supply chain process. Properties: uri
SupplyChainObjectiveSpecification — Objective specification that prescribes what the outcome of a supply chain process should be. Properties: uri
SupplyChainPlanSpecification — Plan specification that has one or more supply chain objective specifications as parts and that prescribes a supply chain process. Properties: uri
SupplyChainProcess — Planned process in which a supply chain plan specification is realized by a number of supply chain agents. Properties: uri

SupplyChainSystem — Engineered system composed of agents, facilities, machines, and information systems that is designed to deliver products and services to end customers through an engineered flow of information, material, and cash. Properties: uri

SupplyChainTransportProcess — Transport process which involves movement of goods between sending trading party’s location and receiving trading party’s locations over the public logistics pathway/infrastructure. Properties: uri
SupplyRelationship — Relationship that exists between two agents when one agent supplies a product or service to another agent and that is prescribed by an agreement. Properties: uri
SupplyingBusinessProcess — Business process wherein a product or service is supplied. Properties: uri
SupportingMaintenanceActivity — Single action in support of the execution of a maintenance process. Properties: uri
System — Collection of elements (object aggregate) that form a unified whole and interact. Properties: uri
SystemCapability — Capability that inheres in a system to the extent of the system's capacity to realize it in some processes. Properties: uri
TemporalDurationValueExpression — Value expression that describes the duration of some temporal interval. Properties: uri
TemporalInstant — (Elucidation) a temporal instant is a zero-dimensional temporal region that has no proper temporal part. Properties: uri
TemporalInstantValueExpression — Value expression that describes the position of a time instant in the time line. Properties: uri, hasDateTimeInstantValue
TemporalInterval — (Elucidation) a temporal interval is a one-dimensional temporal region that is continuous, thus without gaps or breaks. Properties: uri
TemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A temporal region is an occurrent over which processes can unfold. Properties: uri

ThreeDimensionalSpatialRegion — (Elucidation) A three-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a spatial volume together with zero or more spatial volumes and/or spatial regions of lower dimension as parts. Properties: uri
Traceability — Capability of a system to trace the history, application or location of an object. Properties: uri

TraceableResourceUnit — Material entity that is uniquely identified and there may be a need to retrieve information about its history, application, or location as it moves through a supply chain. Properties: uri

TraceableResourceUnitRole — Role held by a number of uniquely identified material entities when they participate in some supply chain processes or production processes while some agent observes them and collects information about them for future retrieval. Properties: uri

TrackingEvent — Event that has at least one traceable resource unit or equipment (with which TRU comes into contact) or operator (that runs an equipment with which TRU comes into contact with at some time) as participant. Properties: uri
Trailer — Container that is unpowered and is pulled by a powered vehicle. Properties: uri
TransportEquipmentRole — Equipment role held by a material artifact when it is planned to be involved in or is involved in carrying out some part of a transport process. Properties: uri
TransportProcess — Material location change process involving the movement of material entities from one location to another as part of a planned logistics process. Properties: uri
TransportationBusinessFunction — Business function that is realized in a transportation service. Properties: uri
TransportationService — Logistics service that consists of at least one transport process. Properties: uri
TransportationServiceProviderRole — Logistics service provider role that is held by a business organization or person when it provides a transportation service. Properties: uri
TravelProcess — Material location change process wherein one or more persons move between geographical locations. Properties: uri

TwoDimensionalSpatialRegion — (Elucidation) A two-dimensional spatial region is a spatial region that is a whole consisting of a surface together with zero or more surfaces and/or spatial regions of lower dimension as parts. Properties: uri
UndesirableDisposition — Disposition of an item to undergo a process that leads to undesirable outcomes. Properties: uri
ValueExpression — Information content entity that contains a value of an entity within a classification scheme or on a quantitative scale. Properties: uri, hasSimpleExpressionValue
Wagon — Container in a rail transport system used for carrying cargo or passengers. Properties: uri
WarehousingPlanSpecification — Plan specification that prescribes a warehousing process. Properties: uri
WarehousingProcess — Business process of storing products (material products) in a storage facility for future use. Properties: uri
Wholesaler — Person or business organization that buys products from distributors and resells them to retailers or other business organizations. Properties: uri
WholesalerRole — Role held by a person or business organization when it buys some product from a distributor and resells them to retailers. Properties: uri
ZeroDimensionalSpatialRegion — (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional spatial region is one or a collection of more than one spatially disjoint points in space. Properties: uri
ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts. Properties: uri
